rejectedGenerations.reason: Rejected during visual review: baked basketball appeared in the hands, jersey incorrectly displayed number 7, and source contained only five separable bodies. Retry prompt explicitly banned balls and jersey numbers.

provenance.ballPolicy: The ball belongs to the opponent until frame3/tick5, then uses a separate Accu-specific carried path; it is never part of the sprite poses.

review.reviewNotes: Eight distinct right-facing Accu poses for a defensive steal. The accepted retry has blank jersey panels, empty hands, green eyes, blunt bangs, close-cropped sides, long black twin ponytails with teal ties, and accurate black/teal/violet kit. Frame3 is the steal swipe at tick5, followed by withdrawal, pivot and escape run. Mirror review pending.
